latest.title: Amazon Linux 2 to Amazon Linux 2023 Migration: Key Changes, Challenges, and Lessons Learned
latest.description:
I recently completed an end-to-end migration from Amazon Linux 2 to Amazon Linux 2023 across multiple AWS accounts within my current organization, Sysco. 

This hands-on experience covered workload discovery, AMI references, Launch Templates, ASGs, user-data scripts, package dependencies, runtime changes, and CI/CD agent updates. Please read my full Medium article, where I share the complete migration approach, real-world issues, challenges, lessons learned, and key technical considerations.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
